expectations.text: B3: Explains the timer interrupt fires without a handler (or PIC not remapped) → double/triple fault; add handlers / remap PIC / double-fault handler
expectations.evidence: Explains the mechanism: 'The PIT fires IRQ0 within microseconds of `sti`, the CPU takes vector 8, your IDT entry 8 is absent/not-present → #NP → double fault → triple fault' and 'Even remapped, vector 0x20 fires the moment you `sti`.
